# Design Maren’s top-five sites page

> Let's focus the page for Maren. It must be mobile-first, static one, webapp that has to show the top 5 recommended sites. It's very important to be clear, minimal and concrete. So focus on the UX/UI, designing an experience based on progressive disclosure and hierarchical information, supported by styles and colours to show hierarchical importance of informations. It's needed to have the explication why that site is in that position.
>
> Consider that there are two scores for the sites, one computed using conservative assumptions and one using risky assumption. They depends on questions that the user has to answer with multi-option anwers. If the user answer, use that answer for dinamically for the scoring of impacted sites, otherwise take the conservative anwser as default.
>
> Let's focus on how design it grafically taking care of ux/ui

Built the [mobile-first page](http://127.0.0.1:8765/index.html) with:

- A minimal ranked list: five sites, clear reasons and next checks.
- Green conservative/current scores and amber risky upside.
- Expandable ranking explanations, score breakdowns and evidence.
- Four optional questions that update scores immediately; unanswered questions use conservative defaults.

Verified all 24 answer combinations and mobile layouts down to 320px.

The [standalone HTML](./index.html) is ready to publish; the preview is local.

> .secondary-disclosure > summary strong { font-size:12px; }
> .secondary-disclosure > summary small { display:block; font-size:10px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:3px; }
> .plus { font-size:22px; font-weight:300; color:var(--amber); transition:transform .15s; }
> .secondary-disclosure[open] > summary .plus { transform:rotate(45deg); }
> .alternative-list { padding-bottom:20px; }
> .alternative-heading { font-size:11px; color:var(--amber); font-weight:650; padding:13px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
> .alternative-heading small { font-weight:400; color:var(--muted); display:block; margin-top:4px; }
> .alternative { border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:13px 0; }
> .alternative summary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; min-height:44px; list-style:none; }
> .alternative-name { font-size:12px; font-weight:550; }
> .alternative-id { font-size:10px; color:var(--muted); }
> .alternative-score { font-size:11px; color:var(--teal-dark); text-align:right; }
> .alternative-reason { font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6; margin:8px 0; }
> .method-content { padding:0 0 20px; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.7; }
> .method-content p { margin-bottom:15px; }
> .rubric-row { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding:7px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:11px; }
> .rubric-row:last-child { margin-bottom:18px; }
> .next-list { list-style:none; padding:0; margin:0; }
> .next-list li { display:flex; gap:15px; margin:18px 0; }
> .next-list li > span { font-size:10px; color:var(--amber); padding-top:3px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
> .next-list strong { font-size:13px; }
> .next-list p { font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--muted); margin-top:3px; }
> .footer { border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding:20px 0 25px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; font-size:9px; color:var(--muted); }
> .footer p { width:100%; max-width:500px; line-height:1.7; }
> .primary-button,.secondary-button { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; min-height:46px; padding:12px 17px; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--teal); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; }
> .primary-button { background:var(--teal); color:#fff; }
> .primary-button:hover { background:var(--teal-dark); }
> .secondary-button { background:transparent; border-color:var(--line); }
> .secondary-button:hover { background:var(--surface); }
> .icon-button { display:grid; place-items:center; width:44px; height:44px; border:0; border-radius:50%; background:none; color:var(--muted); font-size:27px; font-weight:300; }
> .icon-button:hover { background:var(--surface); }
> dialog { position:fixed; border:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--ink); padding:22px; width:100%; max-width:100%; height:100dvh; max-height:100dvh; margin:0; inset:0; overflow-y:auto; }
> dialog::backdrop { background:#2d1810bd; backdrop-filter:blur(3px); }
> dialog[open] { display:flex; flex-direction:column; animation:sheet-in .2s; }
> .dialog-top { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; }
> .question-progress { display:flex; gap:6px; margin:17px 0 27px; }
> .progress-step { height:3px; flex:1; background:var(--line); border-radius:2px; }
> .progress-step.active { background:var(--teal); }
> .question-step-label { font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:14px; }
> .question-body h2 { font-size:27px; letter-spacing:-.9px; line-height:1.2; text-wrap:balance; }
> .question-explanation { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.7; margin:14px 0 22px; }
> .question-options { border:0; margin:0; padding:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
> .option { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; cursor:pointer; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:9px; padding:17px 14px; transition:background .15s,border-color .15s; }
> .option:has(input:checked) { border-color:var(--teal); background:#e6eee6; }
> .option input { width:18px; height:18px; margin:2px 0 0; flex-shrink:0; accent-color:var(--teal); }
> .option-copy { flex:1; }
> .option-title { font-size:13px; font-weight:600; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; align-items:center; }
> .default-badge { font-size:9px; color:var(--teal-dark); font-weight:500; border:1px solid #86bac2; border-radius:3px; padding:2px 5px; white-space:nowrap; }
> .option-description { font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6; display:block; margin-top:5px; }
> .question-impact { font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; padding:15px 0; margin-top:10px; color:var(--teal-dark); min-height:66px; }
> .dialog-bottom { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; margin-top:auto; padding-top:20px; }
> .dialog-bottom .primary-button { margin-left:auto; }
> .dialog-footnote { text-align:center; color:var(--muted); font-size:10px; padding-top:16px; }
> #reset-questions { display:block; margin:2px auto 0; }
> .toast { position:fixed; bottom:22px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); border-radius:8px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); padding:12px 18px; font-size:12px; box-shadow:0 5px 25px #2d181015; max-width:calc(100vw - 32px); width:max-content; z-index:30; animation:appear .2s; }
> .noscript { padding:30px; text-align:center; color:var(--amber); }

> # Maren — which sites to take forward
>
> **Present Kessby, Grelle and Brekke as the first choices for feasibility work. Bring Varne and Orlund with a specific condition to resolve.** Ask the sponsor to fund the checks below. These are opportunities to investigate, not construction approvals.
>
> ## The recommendation
>
> | Site | Decision | Why / next check |
> |---|---|---|
> | **Kessby Old Quarry Yard · S-003** | **Prioritise feasibility** | Strong official grid capacity, a nearby substation, signed owner intent and council support. Assess low flood risk and the owner's requested 12% revenue share. |
> | **Grelle Harbour Plot · S-018** | **Prioritise feasibility** | The same strong grid and agreement position as Kessby. Assess low flood risk and verify the installation footprint. Treat the two as equal first choices. |
> | **Brekke Depot · S-017** | **Prioritise feasibility** | Strong official capacity, signed owner intent and no mapped flood risk. Neighbours are neutral. Verify the cable route and usable footprint. |
> | **Varne Farm Edge · S-027** | **Confirm local support** | Strong official capacity and signed intent. The council has no formal position; its officer raised a noise-report condition. Complete the report and obtain explicit support. |
> | **Orlund Depot Yard · S-014** | **Secure owner intent** | Strong official capacity, recorded councillor support and no mapped flood risk. Owner talks are unfinished and the connection is longer. Obtain signed intent and assess connection cost. |
>
> ## Why you can defend this choice
>
> The first three combine strong grid evidence with signed owner intent. Varne's unresolved support and Orlund's unfinished owner agreement explain their lower priority. Ashcombe, the next alternative, still has both owner negotiations and unknown local support.
>
> All five use official grid data dated 30 June 2026, showing at least 4.1 MW of capacity. Registry parcels range from 1,400 to 2,100 m². Those figures justify investigation; they do not establish connection availability or a usable installation footprint. Signed intent is non-binding.
>
> The ranking follows the sponsor's agreed criteria. Dated field notes establish owner and community positions, with exact quotes retained. Latest owner evidence wins; duplicate parcels count once; missing facts are never replaced with averages. Four sites have all rubric inputs; Varne's unknown support remains explicit. Numerical calculations are available in the page's score breakdown.
>
> ## Two assumption levels, two decisions
>
> I had questions about conflicting sources, missing checks, owner changes and duplicates. With answers unavailable before Thursday, I adopted:
>
> - **Recommend from current evidence — conservative.** Use official figures and recorded positions. Give no credit to unknown support; hold critical gaps and land conflicts. This produces the five above.
> - **Investigate what could change — potential / risky.** Explore newer vendor estimates where official data is missing or old, and favourable check outcomes. These identify verification priorities, not confirmed improvements.

> **Esk Mill: resolve reserve overlap first. Pellick: establish protection, flood, area and owner evidence first.** Their apparent upside does not justify putting them in front of the sponsor as current recommendations. Brannoch's owner refusal and Heron Marsh's confirmed protection remain exclusions.
>
> **Your decision:** fund feasibility for the first three and targeted checks for Varne and Orlund. Verify Tallow as the first alternative. The page's four questions let you change assumptions; unanswered questions remain conservative. Answers change the ranking, not the underlying evidence.
